summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload unrelated to package purpose
details: @servicetitan/titan-chat-ui-anvil2@9.0.1 declares a `preinstall` hook that runs `node setup.mjs`. When `bun` is not already on PATH, `setup.mjs` downloads a platform-specific Bun runtime binary from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and uses it to invoke a shipped `math_init.js` file via `execFileSync`. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB heavily obfuscated JavaScript bundle (marked `// @bun @bun-cjs`) using a shuffled numeric/string constant array with randomized `_0x`-style identifiers; `setup.mjs` uses the same obfuscator.io-style naming, concealing loader intent. The package is advertised as a React chat-UI library, which has no legitimate need to fetch a second JavaScript runtime at install time and use it to execute an obfuscated sibling script. The install-time-executed payload runs with the installer's privileges before any consumer code executes.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
